news: DAY 06 // The surveillance grid goes dark. Lark opens the research, June publishes the records, and Null keeps the channels alive. You built more than a career. The planet is a little harder to own.
DAY 05 // The whistleblower escapes the financial dragnet and releases a list of surveillance contracts. Aegis starts taking systems offline.
DAY 04 // The shell company belongs to Aegis. A private security contract is turning public research into private leverage.
DAY 03 // The records link Aegis's contractor to Morrow's debt platform. Three unrelated jobs begin to look like one story.
DAY 02 // Thousands of duplicate balances disappear. Morrow replaces a maintenance identity; its perimeter gets a little stronger.
DAY 01 // An anonymous prototype appears on the open net. Helix's demonstration goes ahead, but the technology is no longer theirs alone.
EXCHANGE ONLINE // A new operator has entered the network. Your first contract is waiting.
